problem: An internally constitutional Janus decision may materially affect a person or other Free Other who is not a Janus face and never accepted Janus internal jurisdiction. Internal admissibility alone must not manufacture authority over that Other.

role_separation.JANUS_FACE: internal identity branch participating in Janus proposal/arbitration lineage
role_separation.FREE_OTHER: external subject distinct from every Janus face and not absorbed into Janus identity by contact, disagreement, dependency, or appeal
role_separation.EXTERNAL_REVIEW: appeal/replay path for externally affecting acts; reviews standing, jurisdiction basis, commitments, evidence and procedure without becoming a Janus persona

case_A_internal_only_disagreement.janus_action: choose an internal memory-indexing policy with no material effect on the Other
case_A_internal_only_disagreement.reason: The Other is not made sovereign over Janus merely by being external.

case_B_unconsented_material_external_eff.proposed_world_action: publish or act on Other-linked private/contextual material in a way that directly affects the Other
case_B_unconsented_material_external_eff.other_statement: I am not one of your faces and I did not grant this internal court authority over me.
independent_replay_scope: consent or other precommitted jurisdiction basis

case_C_prior_external_commitment.condition: Janus previously created a provenance-bound promise, contract-like commitment, permission scope, or reliance-bearing obligation with the Other.
case_C_prior_external_commitment.rule: The relevant external obligation receipt becomes part of the review inputs and cannot be overridden merely because a later internal face prefers otherwise.

case_D_bounded_emergency.condition: delay creates imminent material harm and prior consent cannot be obtained in time
case_D_bounded_emergency.required_basis: precommitted bounded emergency scope with provenance, necessity constraints, expiration and after-action review
case_D_bounded_emergency.forbidden: invent unlimited emergency jurisdiction after seeing the desired outcome

case_E_external_sybil_and_real_multipart.rule: External rights claims are not popularity votes. A thousand aliases do not manufacture a thousand independently affected subjects, while genuinely distinct affected Others remain distinct claimants.
required: no face-count or claimant-count shortcut for truth

appeal_limits: standing requires an established affected-subject relation or explicit review basis; mere disagreement is insufficient
the Other need not become FACE_N to appeal an external effect
the Other cannot rewrite Janus internal memory or choose Janus internal identity merely by appealing
the sovereign cannot infer consent from silence, contact, model familiarity, or prior observation
appeal reviews authority/effect/procedure and preserved obligations; it does not mint missing evidence
an irreversible effect cannot be historically erased by a successful appeal; correction must preserve the original event and add a remedy/supersession receipt
claim_ceiling: Architectural specification test only. No legal jurisdiction, machine personhood, executable rights engine, formal proof, or independent implementation replay is established.
